function.description: This function scans a database log file for lines indicating transaction completion or failure, extracting the last transaction ID that matches the criteria. encoding.description: The encoding of the log file. This is JavaScript String type parameter in string representation.

processFunction.description: A function that processes the extracted transaction ID. This parameter can be of any type of JavaScript object in string representation.
